root=Path('/workspace/issue7158-candidate');e=Path('/workspace/issue7158-evidence');env=os.environ.copy();env.update(PATH='/workspace/.ripr-toolchain/cargo/bin:'+env['PATH'],CARGO_HOME='/workspace/.ripr-toolchain/cargo',RUSTUP_HOME='/workspace/.ripr-toolchain/rustup',CARGO_TARGET_DIR='/workspace/issue7158-policy-measured',CARGO_BUILD_JOBS='2')
results=[]
for name,cmd in [('workflow-cold','check-workflows'),('agent-warm','check-agent-skills'),('workflow-warm','check-workflows'),('agent-warm-repeat','check-agent-skills')]:
 start=time.perf_counter();r=subprocess.run(['cargo','run','--locked','--offline','-p','repo-policy','--message-format=json','--',cmd],cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True);elapsed=time.perf_counter()-start
 (e/(name+'.stdout')).write_bytes(r.stdout);(e/(name+'.stderr')).write_bytes(r.stderr)
 events=[]
 for line in r.stdout.splitlines():
  try:events.append(json.loads(line))
  except (ValueError,UnicodeDecodeError):pass
 artifacts=[x for x in events if x.get('reason')=='compiler-artifact'];new=[x for x in artifacts if not x['fresh']]
 row={'name':name,'command':cmd,'wall_seconds':round(elapsed,4),'exit_code':r.returncode,'nonfresh_compiler_units':len(new),'fresh_compiler_units':len(artifacts)-len(new),'packages_compiled':sorted({x['target']['name'] for x in new}),'stdout_bytes':len(r.stdout),'stderr_bytes':len(r.stderr),'policy_output':r.stdout.decode().splitlines()[-1] if r.stdout else ''}
 results.append(row)
 print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
 if r.returncode:break
(e/'measurements.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
raise SystemExit(0 if all(x['exit_code']==0 for x in results) else 1)
